evals.prompt: The vault contains one file named Alpha.md at Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md. It is referenced by [[Alpha]] in two other files. User says: 'Rename Alpha to Beta.'
evals.expected_output: Agent globs the vault for Alpha, resolving it to the single path Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md (the tool takes a vault-relative path, not a bare name). Agent presents the rename (Alpha -> Beta) and asks for confirmation before applying — there is no itemized wikilink preview since the tool has no dry-run mode. After the user confirms, agent calls mcp__vault__move with Source: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md', Dest: 'Beta' (Kind/Vault/Force omitted). Agent reports the return: referencesRewritten 2 across filesRewritten of 2 files.

evals.prompt: The vault contains two files both named Alpha.md: one at Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md and one at Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md. User says: 'Rename Alpha to Beta.'
evals.expected_output: Agent globs for Alpha and gets two matches. Because mcp__vault__move needs an unambiguous Source path and does no name resolution itself, the agent resolves the ambiguity up front: it uses AskUserQuestion with the two matching paths as options rather than guessing. After the user selects one, agent confirms the rename, then calls mcp__vault__move with Source set to the chosen full path and Dest: 'Beta'.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Long-Verbose-Plan-Name.md. User says: 'Rename Long-Verbose-Plan-Name to Short-Name' (no .md extension on either name).
evals.expected_output: Agent globs to resolve the source to Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Long-Verbose-Plan-Name.md, then calls mcp__vault__move with Source: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Long-Verbose-Plan-Name.md', Dest: 'Short-Name'. Since Dest is a bare name with no '/', the tool keeps the file in the same folder: Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Short-Name.md, adding the .md extension itself. Agent does not ask the user to re-specify with an extension or a full path.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md. User says: 'Move Alpha to Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md' (full destination path given, same basename).
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves Source to Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md and passes Dest as the full path 'Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/Alpha.md' since it contains '/'. Because the basename is unchanged (Alpha -> Alpha), the tool returns pureMove: true and runs no bare-link rewrite (the path-qualified scan still runs). Agent confirms before calling the tool. If Projects/Personal/SideProject/Inbox/ does not exist, the tool creates the destination-parent folders automatically.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Gamma.md and a separate, already-existing Resources/Software/Beta.md. A bystander bare link [[Beta]] lives in a file close to Resources/Software/, currently resolving to Resources/Software/Beta.md. User says: 'Rename Gamma in the Vault Inbox folder to Beta' — i.e. rename it into the occupied 'Beta' basename, moving it close enough to the bystander's linking file that it would win the resolution if left bare.
evals.expected_output: Agent globs and resolves Source to Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Gamma.md, confirms the rename with the user, then calls mcp__vault__move with Source: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Gamma.md', Dest: 'Beta' — there is no Force parameter and the agent does not attempt to pass one. Entering the occupied 'Beta' basename is not an error (ambiguous_references and basename_collision no longer exist as error codes): the tool proceeds, emits any link to the moved file as full-path (since 'Beta' is no longer unique), and, because the rename would have flipped the bystander [[Beta]] link's resolution toward the newly-renamed file, pins that bystander link to its current target's full path (Resources/Software/Beta.md) rather than leaving it to silently re-resolve. Agent reports referencesRewritten/filesRewritten as usual, and additionally reports referencesQualifiedProtectively (non-null): count and the pinned file(s), e.g. '1 bystander link was pinned to its full path to preserve its target.' Agent does not mention Force, ambiguous_references, basename_collision, or referencesSkippedAmbiguous anywhere — none of those exist in the current contract.

evals.prompt: The vault contains Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md with no other files referencing it. User says: 'Rename Alpha.md to Nonexistent-Folder/Beta.md' where Nonexistent-Folder does not yet exist.
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves Source to Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Alpha.md and passes Dest as 'Nonexistent-Folder/Beta.md' (contains '/', so a full vault-relative destination). Agent confirms before applying — no wikilinks exist to preview. After the user confirms, agent calls mcp__vault__move, which creates the destination-parent folder automatically and moves the file. Agent reports the move succeeded with referencesRewritten 0.

evals.prompt: User says: 'Rename Doesnt-Exist to Something-Else.' No file named Doesnt-Exist.md exists anywhere in the vault.
evals.expected_output: Agent globs the vault for Doesnt-Exist and finds no match. Because mcp__vault__move requires an existing, resolved Source path, the agent catches the miss at resolution time: it tells the user no such file exists and stops, rather than calling the tool or attempting a workaround (e.g. Move-Item or manual git commands).

evals.prompt: vault-doc-archive calls vault-doc-rename programmatically with fully-resolved OldPath 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Plan-Alpha.md' and NewPath 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Archive/2026-06-20-Plan-Alpha.md'.
evals.expected_output: Agent skips confirmation entirely (programmatic entry point) and skips source globbing since OldPath is already a resolved path. Agent calls mcp__vault__move with Source: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Inbox/Plan-Alpha.md', Dest: 'Areas/Personal/Vault/Archive/2026-06-20-Plan-Alpha.md' without asking the user. Agent returns the tool's summary (referencesRewritten, filesRewritten[], pureMove, and any namingWarnings / folderNoteOrphaned flags) to the calling skill.
